paper.title: Communication Compression for Byzantine Robust Learning: New Efficient Algorithms and Improved Rates

algorithm.name: Byz-DASHA-PAGE (Algorithm 2), Rand-1 and bucketed coordinatewise median
citations: PDF p.17, Appendix B.1 Coordinate-wise Median and Algorithm 5
PDF p.18, Appendix B.2 RandK sparsification
assumptions: Smooth strongly convex finite-sum quadratic objectives on regular workers.
One Byzantine worker with explicit arbitrary estimator states; no objective assigned to it.
Unbiased uniform one-component gradient differences and Rand-1 compression, conditioned on supported draws.
Recurrence validation only; no assertion that this finite fixture verifies asymptotic robustness constants or theorem stepsize restrictions.
Other proposed methods (Byz-VR-MARINA 2.0, Byz-EF21 and Byz-EF21-BC) are outside this contract.

cases.purpose: Exercise both PAGE refresh/difference branches, Rand-1 compression with nonzero momentum memory, and bucketed robust aggregation under a malicious worker.

inputs.network: One synchronous server and 6 workers, indices 0..5; workers 0..4 honest, worker 5 Byzantine.
inputs.objective: f=(1/5)*sum_i f_i over honest workers only; f_i=(f_i0+f_i1)/2, f_ij(x)=sum_k(q[i][j][k]*x[k]^2/2+b[i][j][k]*x[k]).
inputs.initialization: h_i^0=g_i^0=full local gradient at x0. Server g0 is computed by the specified bucketed median using Byzantine state at index 0 and permutation at index 0.
inputs.aggregator: Algorithm 5 with bucket size s=2 and coordinatewise median: permute all 6 g_i states, average consecutive disjoint pairs, then take median separately in each coordinate over 3 pair means. No extra averaging.
inputs.oracle: On refresh, full mean of two component gradients. Otherwise sample exactly one listed component j and set delta_hat_i=grad f_ij(x_next)-grad f_ij(x_old), same j at both points. Component indices are zero-based and ignored at refresh steps.
inputs.compressor: Unbiased Rand-1 in d=2: keep exactly the listed coordinate and multiply it by 2; zero other coordinate. Uniform independent coordinate selection before conditioning.
inputs.randomness: Fixed supported realizations: listed Bernoulli PAGE coins (p=1/2), uniform component indices, uniform compressor coordinates, and uniform permutations. All arrays chronological; rows of samples/keep cover five honest workers. Byzantine states include initialization plus each post-update state; a malicious increment may equivalently be chosen as consecutive state difference.
inputs.observations: step s=t+1 after Algorithm 2 line 16. x uses previous server g; h is after lines 7-11; compression_input is the argument to Q in line 12; message is Q output; g_regular after line 13; bucket_means and g_aggregate come from current complete local states (not raw increments); objective at updated x.
